{{Quote|Like all our worlds, this one has no name that you would understand.|[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]]|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>}}
A '''planet''' located in the [[Atoan system]], in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]], was covered by tar pits generating [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of boiling tar. It was inhabited by [[Atoan]]s from the neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]].

==History==
[[File:Battle_of_the_Atoan_tar-pit_planet.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT walkers]] fighting in the pit oceans.]]
A [[Atoan insurgency|major campaign]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] took place in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The planet was [[Battle of the Atoan tar-pit planet|attacked]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] who had been led to believe that they were responsible for the disappearance of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]]. In actuality, he had defected to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], [[High Priest/Legends|High Priestess]] of Atoa, one of the rulers of the system.
